answer: Work waits on the jetty until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the delta of the next round. The willow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
